_doc: Stream W (Expansion 1). The prop vocabulary of Vharlen's own wilderness dressing — the ONLY prop/ground ids an island recipe (data/vignettes/vharlen-wayside.json, vharlen-curios.json, vharlen-vignettes.json, the folk `props` of data/provinces/vharlen-travellers.json, the farms/forts of vharlen-sites.json) may use. `island` ids are drawn by js/client/vharl-props.js (low-poly, vertex-coloured, instanced by js/client/decor.js like every kit prop; the local X axis is the long axis, +z is the front/opening); `kit` ids are neutral pieces of the shared highdef-3d kit that read as nothing in particular (a crate, a barrel, a campfire). Anything else from the kit (hay bales, fences, wells, sawhorses, oaks, birches, pines, scarecrows, mushroom rings…) is Torbor Downs' look and is banned on the island — tests/W/vharlen-dressing.test.js checks it (and that js/client/vharl-props.js draws exactly these ids). `size` = metres across (long axis), `h` = height, `fire: true` = it burns (a flame and a light).
